summary: Inaugural session. Note on honesty of this timestamp: the session began earlier than this entry. The log was instituted mid session, after the first three commits, because the root commit was required to hold the preregistration and nothing else. The three entries that follow record work already committed, and their commit hashes are the verifiable record of when that work landed.

Term gate run before the root commit. Declared queries fixed before their results were read. Verdict recorded: the compound is unoccupied, the two words together sit in the retrieval basin of the conditioning literature, and the source theorem calls the object a matching.
Both cited works resolved and confirmed to exist and to say what this lane was told. Neither read in full. The version suffix of the arXiv record is unverified.

Preregistration written and signed as the root commit, holding that document alone. Question, family, null, statistic, refutation criterion with its own verifiability check, multiplicity rule, disclaimers, sample size and seed.
Contact rules committed. Read only access to the deposited neighbours at their tags, untouchable stays untouchable, the remote recorded as it actually is, third party files under a manifest.

Gates built and tested: dash gate with a single narrow exemption, effort log with a hash chain and session structure checks, figure gate for commit messages backed by a registry, hooks versioned and installable, and a test suite that tries to break each gate.
Background review opened as UNSTARTED with its scope, its queued leads flagged as unread, its standing prohibition on novelty claims, and its closing condition.

Defect found and corrected forward on first run of the dash gate: the gate and its tests carried the forbidden characters as literals in their own source, so the enforcer failed its own rule. Corrected by writing them as codepoint escapes rather than by granting the enforcer an exemption. The history sweep over the three commits made before the gate existed passed clean.

Defect register opened. Two entries: the dash gate carrying the characters it forbids, caught by itself before it landed; and the apparatus commit carrying four documents its message does not describe, caught after it landed and corrected forward rather than rewritten. One known limitation recorded, that the figure gate refuses identifiers as well as figures.
